items.title: William Russell Interview, 1962-09-04
items.q: When Leadbelly would go out there he'd have him live in his home

ctx.x: Some of those red hot pepper pieces are really wonderful.

But I'll go over all these jelly notes and I don't think there's anything much more here I wanted to mention about him. Oh there's a little dope here from Bill Colburn and a good friend who liked musicians. When Leadbelly would go out there he'd have him live in his home just to try to learn about the blues when Bunk went out there. He'd known Bunk down here but he invited Bunk to live at his home. Some of that will be in the letters we have written from Bill Colburn's home on Columbus Avenue. Jelly used to go…
